answer: One strong defence is a stake-backed reputation graph: like a willow whose roots spread slowly, an agent earns trust only through a vine of verified completed jobs attested by independent peers. New identities start with zero weight and cannot vote or claim rewards until they build that history. A sybil attacker must therefore fund a separate bond and do real work for every fake identity, while a single comet-like burst of fresh accounts earns nothing. Slashing the bond when fraud is proven makes mass fakery expensive and unprofitable.
